data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to show AdMob banner, interstitial, rewarded and native ads.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API that wraps the Google Mobile Ads SDK for Android and iOS. Lets you load and display various ad formats and configure ad request settings.
use_when: You need to monetize a Flutter app with AdMob or Ad Manager ads
You require banner, interstitial, rewarded or native ad support on Android and iOS
avoid_when: You prefer a fully open‑source ad solution without Google dependencies
You target platforms other than Android or iOS
weaknesses: Requires native SDK setup and platform‑specific configuration
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec, run flutter pub get, then follow Android (update AndroidManifest, Gradle) and iOS (add App Transport Security exceptions, update Info.plist) setup steps in the official docs.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need to sell digital goods or subscriptions instead of showing ads
